why: Study v1 kept only videos whose title contains the dish name and scored relevance with the same rule, so it could not see famous or English-titled videos and graded its filter with itself. v2 separates candidate generation, relevance judgement and ranking, and validates the judge against labels written before the judge ran.

dishes.source: the 40 dishes of study v1 (criteria.json of youtube_discovery: cached + extra)
dishes.added: none: the dishes that failed in v1 (A kept <= 1: pork-kimchi-fried-rice, sausage-stir, pork-lettuce, hotdog-pan) are already in the 40
dishes.paired_set: the first 20 dishes of v1 'extra' (they get a live search.list call); the 10 cached dishes keep no candidate pool, so A1 does not exist for them

stage1_candidates.A1: YouTube search.list, order=relevance, 25 results, videoEmbeddable=true, regionCode=KR, relevanceLanguage=ko, query '<dish> 레시피' (the production query). Search cap: 20 calls, one per paired dish.
stage1_candidates.A2: YouTube search.list, order=viewCount, 25 results. NOT run today: the search cap is spent on A1 (the baseline). Pending; listed in the README.
stage1_candidates.B: google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite:online asked for the most popular, best-regarded YouTube recipe videos of the dish, any language, up to 8, watch URLs checked in search results. Ids from the answer and its url citations (first 12).
stage1_candidates.B2: B plus the instruction to prefer the videos with the most views.
stage1_candidates.U: union of A1, B and B2 candidates (paired set only)
stage1_candidates.enrichment: one videos.list (snippet, contentDetails, statistics, status) per dish for the union of all ids (at most 50). A candidate is usable only if public and embeddable (API fields).

stage2_judges.J0: old rule: title contains the dish name (spaces/punctuation ignored)
stage2_judges.J1: selector LLM judge google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite, temperature 0, one call per dish listing all its candidates, strict JSON {judgements:[{i, relevant, reason}]}; input: dish name and aliases, title, channel, duration, description (500 chars), tags (8)
stage2_judges.E: evaluator LLM judge google/gemini-2.5-flash (a different, stronger model so selection is not graded by itself), same prompt and format; used only to compute Precision@3
stage2_judges.rubric: relevant = the video's main content is cooking this dish (any language, any popular variant of it). Irrelevant = a different dish, vlog, mukbang (eating show), product advertisement, compilation or video where the dish is a side mention.
stage2_judges.validation: 60 videos drawn with seed 20261116 from the enriched candidates: 20 Korean titles naming the dish, 15 Korean titles not naming it, 15 non-Hangul titles, 10 videos of 60 s or less (short); a stratum with too few videos is filled from the others. The assistant writes labels from the same fields BEFORE any judge call and commits them (one labeler, a draft). Each judge (J0, J1, E) is compared with the labels: agreement, precision, recall, Cohen's kappa.
stage2_judges.trust: a judge is trusted only with kappa >= 0.6 against the labels. If E is not trusted, no decision is made. If J1 is not trusted, J1 combinations are excluded from the decision.

stage3_rankings.like_ratio: likes/views, only videos with >= 1000 views (others rank last)
stage3_rankings.views_channel: most viewed first but at most one video per channel; repeated channels only fill empty slots

combinations: method in {A1, B, B2, U} x judge in {J0, J1} x ranking in {views, like_ratio, recency, views_channel} = 32; all computed on the paired 20 dishes. B and B2 are also reported on all 40 dishes.

metrics.p3: mean over dishes of (chosen videos the evaluator E calls relevant) / 3 (empty slots count as misses)
metrics.precision_chosen: relevant chosen / chosen, over all dishes pooled
metrics.coverage: share of dishes where the combination chooses 3 videos
metrics.zero_relevant: dishes where no chosen video is relevant under E
metrics.median_views: median views of the chosen videos
metrics.english_kept: number of chosen videos whose title has no Hangul and that E calls relevant
metrics.embeddable_share_of_chosen: 1.0 by construction (usable is a hard filter); the share of usable candidates before the filter is reported per method
metrics.cost: OpenRouter cost per dish of the method's own discovery calls, plus the selector judge call for J1 combinations
metrics.search_calls: search.list calls per dish of the method

decision_rule: Among the trusted combinations whose coverage is at least 0.9 x the best coverage, choose the highest p3; ties go to the lower cost, then to fewer search calls. Report the per-dish paired difference of the winner against the baseline (A1 + J0 + views) with a 95% percentile bootstrap interval (10,000 resamples of dishes, seed 20261116); the result is called inconclusive when the interval contains 0.

budget.planned_model_calls: B 40 + B2 40 + J1 selector 40 + E 40 + validation 2 (J1, E) = 162

limits_declared: single run; one labeler; judges are LLMs of one vendor family; 40 dishes (20 paired); 32 combinations are compared, so the best one is optimistic; relevance is judged from metadata, not from the video content
